+Nuxt 5 ships `nuxt/server`, an import surface for the server utilities server code reaches for most: `defineHandler`, `createError`, `getQuery`, `readBody`, the cookie and header helpers, `sendRedirect`, `getRouteRules` and `useRuntimeConfig`.

In Nuxt 4, server code imports these from `h3` or gets them as auto-imports, which ties it to h3 v1 and `nitropack`. Importing from `nuxt/server` instead works with whichever [`server.builder`](/docs/guide/going-further/builders) is configured, so one file can serve Nuxt 4.6 (running either `nitropack` v2 or Nitro v3) and Nuxt 5.
+`nuxt/server` also exports `defineEventHandler` as an alias of `defineHandler`, so renaming your handlers is optional.
